Setup

An Azure VM running Apache, MariaDB and OpenSSH, reachable by solvers over WireGuard.

I wrote both the lab configuration and the solve write-up. The lab is built to stay stable for many solvers at once: no brute force, and the exploit path changes no files, cron jobs, services or database rows.

Redacted on purpose: Logins · Flag · Host

What I did

A leftover backup file leaks database credentials, the database leaks an SSH login, and a narrowly scoped sudo rule on less allows a shell escape to root. The write-up has a findings table: 1 critical, 2 high, 1 low.

Results

A backup file left in the webroot and sudo rights on an interactive binary (less) opened a path to root.

Log signal: auditd execve of /bin/sh with parent process less

Next

Remove backup files from production servers and restrict sudo by least privilege.

Withheld on purpose: credentials , flags and lab IPs .
